title: Pacific Venture Sportfishing & Charters

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Spend more time on the water and explore some of Southern California's most productive coastal fishing grounds with our 8 Hour Inshore Charter. This extended inshore trip is perfect for anglers who want additional time to locate active fish, cover more territory, and enjoy a full day of sportfishing without heading far offshore. This 8-hour private fishing charter runs from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM and accommodates up to 6 guests. Depending on the season and conditions, anglers may target rock cod, calico bass, sheepshead, halibut, shark, and seasonal yellowtail. The extra time allows our crew to adapt to changing conditions, fish multiple locations, and maximize opportunities throughout the day.
